record.question: This tree_________ around longer than you.
record.explanation: Answer A: has been. The present perfect “has been” works with “longer than you” and the continuing state. Independent check: “Has been around” is the present-perfect form expressing duration up to now; the singular “tree” takes has. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/present-perfect-simple-i-have-worked. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
